n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
fact_array = [0] * maxn
inv_fact_array = [0] * maxn
invs_array = [0] * maxn

def precompute():
    fact_array[0] = fact_array[1] = invs_array[1] = inv_fact_array[0] = inv_fact_array[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, maxn):
        fact_array[i] = (fact_array[i-1] * i) % mod
        invs_array[i] = mod - (mod // i) * invs_array[mod % i] % mod
        inv_fact_array[i] = (inv_fact_array[i-1] * invs_array[i]) % mod

def choose(a, b):
    return (fact_array[a] * (inv_fact_array[b] * inv_fact_array[a - b] % mod)) % mod

def total_pairs_sum(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

precompute()

fct_arr = [0] * maxn
cst_arr = [0] * maxn
dp1_alt = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
dp2_alt = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

fct_arr[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        val = (choose(i - 1, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod
        val = (val * fct_arr[i - 1 - j]) % mod
        fct_arr[i] = (fct_arr[i] + val) % mod

        cst_contrib = (choose(i - 1, j) * (total_pairs_sum(j) + total_pairs_sum(i - 1 - j))) % mod
        cst_contrib = (cst_contrib * (fct_arr[j] * fct_arr[i - 1 - j] % mod)) % mod
        cst_arr[i] = (cst_arr[i] + cst_contrib) % mod

        cst_contrib2 = (choose(i - 1, j) * (total_pairs_sum(j) + total_pairs_sum(i - 1 - j))) % mod
        cst_contrib2 = (cst_contrib2 * (fct_arr[j] * fct_arr[i - 1 - j] % mod)) % mod
        cst_arr[i] = (cst_arr[i] + cst_contrib2) % mod

    fct_arr[i] = (fct_arr[i] * (i + 1)) % mod

dp1_alt[0][0] = 1
for k in range(1, n + 1):
    dp1_alt[k][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, min(m, k) + 1):
        dp1_alt[k][i] = dp1_alt[k - 1][i]
        dp2_alt[k][i] = dp2_alt[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val1 = (choose(i, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod
            val1 = (val1 * dp1_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            dp1_alt[k][i] = (dp1_alt[k][i] + val1) % mod

            val2 = (choose(i, j) * cst_arr[j]) % mod
            val2 = (val2 * dp1_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val2) % mod

            val3 = (choose(i, j) * fct_arr[j]) % mod
            val3 = (val3 * dp2_alt[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            dp2_alt[k][i] = (dp2_alt[k][i] + val3) % mod

print(dp2_alt[n][m])
